question_summary: Crew discovered an existing utility line conflicting with the slab-on-grade at Pour 3 and requests approval to locally shift the layout while holding the remainder per plan.
proposed_solution: Shift the layout locally around the conflicting utility and keep all other work per plan.
deadline_text: A response next week would still let us stay on track.
routing_rationale: Conflict involves existing utilities beneath the slab, which is under the civil/site utilities scope and requires civil design direction on layout adjustments.
